messages.stuck.reply_none: The session already settled these messages; nothing changed.
messages.stuck.card:
Your choice: {who} claimed {claimed} messages and has not finished them after {age}; {behind} newer messages are blocked behind them
Redeliver = put them back in the queue for the session to claim again; Mark as handled = settle them, no more delivery; Leave it = change nothing this time.
messages.stuck.cleared: ✅ These messages are no longer stuck (the session settled them, or they were handed over); nothing to do
